findings.desc: quality: packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:598-617 (capText/boundPersistedFindings) silently caps each persisted finding field (title<=200, file<=300, description<=1000, fix<=1000 chars) with no truncation marker. Array-level truncation IS auditable (findingCount stays the TRUE count while findings.length can be <=50, so a reader can detect the array was capped), but per-field truncation is silent: capText() just slices, so a reader of the persisted verdict JSON or --json output cannot tell whether a title/description/fix was cut short vs organically that length. This undermines the CHK-004 goal of the artifact being a trustworthy, complete-or-visibly-incomplete audit record.
